The kiosk design and installation shall prov ide adequate flexibility for adjustment, positioning, and alignment at site. The Bidder sh all ensure that the proposed solution is fully compatible, integrated, and ready for operation upon commiss ioning. 4. 4. The escalation matrix shall cover technical support, service-relate d issues, and further escalation to the appropriate OEM/authorized support team. 5. 5. OEM Service Branch and Spare/Warehouse Facility: The OEM shall have an established service branch a nd warehouse facility with adequate inventory of essential spare parts and standby units to ensure prompt , efficient, and uninterrupted service support for a minimum period of three (3) years from the date of com missioning. The OEM shall maintain sufficient stock of critical spares and standby equipment to facilitate ti mely resolution of service calls and minimize downtime. 6. 6. Mandatory OEM Certifications and Compliance: The OEM shall possess and maintain valid and current c ertifications/compliances, as applicable to the proposed solution, for the following standards and certificati ons:

LED Data Wall Display BIS, EPR compliance; RoHS 4. Wireless Joystick WPC ETA, BIS; EPR 5. Wired Headphones for Kiosk BIS; EPR compliance 6. Wireless Headphones WPC ETA; BIS, EPR 7. PlayStation Joystick / Controller BIS; WPC ETA, if wireless; EPR compliance The Bidder shall submit valid documentary evidence/certificates for the above certifications and complianc es along with the bid. 7. .7. The Bidder shall conduct an online/offline demonstration of the proposed software solution, covering th e relevant use-case scenarios and applications specified in the tender .
